paper_title: Improved axion emissivity from a supernova via nucleon-nucleon bremsstrahlung
notes: SN 1987A cooling bound from improved nucleon-nucleon axion bremsstrahlung. Headline constraint is Eq. (3.3): g_an^2 + 0.61 g_ap^2 + 0.53 g_an g_ap <= 8.26e-19, from requiring L_a <= L_nu ~ 2e52 erg/s. Reported as the bound on g_ap with g_an = 0: g_ap <= sqrt(8.26e-19/0.61) = 1.16e-9, matching the paper's quoted KSVZ result g_ap <~ 1.2e-9 (m_a <~ 15 meV; Table 2, OPE+corr.+MS, and conclusions). Paper's Lagrangian Eq. (2.2) already uses the canonical dimensionless normalization L = (g_aN/2m_N) dmu(a) Nbar gamma^mu gamma5 N, so no conversion applied. The bound is mass-independent in the free-streaming regime; flat line drawn over 1e-12 to 1 eV (trapping only matters at couplings ~1e-6-1e-7, far above this bound). No statistical confidence level is stated (energy-loss criterion, not a likelihood analysis). Not a dark-matter search, so no local density assumed.
